hypothesis: Deterministic 96-event multi-city pilotta en az bir locked horizonda eventlerin en az %20'si ve research city'lerin en az 30'u, tum bucket'larda cutoff-oncesi ve en fazla 12 saat stale indicative YES price vectorune sahiptir.

sample_selection.method: Sort each city's events by target_date then event_id; choose the lower-median event from the early half and lower-median event from the late half.

horizon_point_rule: For each YES token choose the latest price timestamp <= endDate minus horizon; future points are forbidden.

full_vector_rule.normalization: Report raw YES-price sum and normalize positive complete vectors to sum to one only for later scoring; coverage is assessed before normalization.

known_before_preregistration.chicago_prior_price_history_probe: 30/30 events and 330/330 tokens had any history; multi-horizon complete-vector coverage was not measured.
